falsification_conditions.condition: The S&P 500 index closes above 5,200 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained breakout above this key resistance level would indicate a bullish trend reversal, contradicting the blowoff pattern's bearish implications.

falsification_conditions.condition: The 20-day moving average of Bitcoin's trading volume falls below 10% of its 2024-Aug bottom level
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Such a volume collapse would invalidate the pattern match by showing a lack of market participation typically seen during blowoff phases.

falsification_conditions.condition: The CBOE VIX index drops below 12 for 5 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained period of extremely low volatility would contradict the blowoff score's implication of imminent market stress or reversal.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
